unica.note: Single public Unica stdio MCP orchestrator. Source checkouts start the Rust binary through cargo with a plugin-root-relative Cargo manifest path. The public marketplace package rewrites this entry into a command-scoped Git alias that resolves the plugin root and hands it to the packaged bootstrap launcher, which verifies the pinned runtime before launching unica; only the development-only local debug package rewrites it to the host-target unica binary.
